concerns.text: FR-003 requires classifying candidates as 'consistently accepted' (>0.9) and excluding them as 'mastered'. Task T021 (CAP classifier) description only mentions calculating mean/variance and classifying as 'rejected/fluctuating/accepted' but fails to explicitly state the exclusion logic for 'consistently accepted' candidates in the task description, creating ambiguity on whether the exclusion step is covered.

FR-008 mandates injecting Gaussian noise (σ=0.05) into confidence scores 'at each step' of the simulation. Task T026 places noise injection in 'generators.py' (data generation phase). No task explicitly covers injecting noise during the training loop (base_zppo.py or cap_zppo.py) for each step, risking the requirement is only met at data generation time rather than per-step.

SC-002 requires measuring the 'Standard Deviation of the AUCC' between variants. Tasks T029 (t-test), T030 (forgetting check), and T032 (report generation) do not explicitly mention calculating or reporting the Standard Deviation of the AUCC distribution, only the difference in AUCC and p-values.

The spec defines an edge case where 'all candidates are pruned' requiring a fallback to the 'full set'. Task T020 tests 'empty prompt fallback' generally, and T022 mentions 'min threshold enforcement', but neither explicitly covers the specific logic of defaulting to the 'full set' when *all* candidates are pruned due to high confidence, leaving a gap in test coverage for this specific scenario.

Task T013 description mentions 'MMLU held-out data loader... no synthetic fallback', but the spec's Edge Cases section requires the system to 'fail gracefully with a clear error message' if data is missing. The task description does not explicitly mention implementing the error handling logic for missing data, only the loading mechanism.
